newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Nova Scotia Power ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Nova Scotia Power ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday it has confirmed the ratings of Nova Scotia Power Inc's unsecured debentures and debt at A (low) with a stable trend.
The company's debt was issued prior to its June 1993 privatization and was guaranteed by the provincial government.
DBRS also confirmed the company's preferred share ratings and commercial paper ratings at Pfd-2 and R-1 (low) respectively, with a stable trend.
"The utility continues to generate sufficient cash flows to meet internal needs and allow for debt repayment on a small scale," DBRS said in a statement.
DBRS said it expects the trend to continue over the next two years, but said earnings and cash flow could be hurt in 1999 when the utility becomes fully taxable.
